# v1 kernel stores (R-13d compatibility)

Two kernel stores written in the v1 event format (a full state snapshot per event), by the
kernel at two commits:

- `v1-e774ba2/`: before R-13c; persisted envelopes are kept in hex;
- `v1-efc0892/`: after R-13c; persisted envelopes are kept as `envelope_digest`.

Each holds 13 events (init, two delegations, two admissions, an invocation, allocate,
release, persist, two consumes, an R-12 expiry and the grant that recorded it) and
`checkpoint.json`, the full checkpoint that kernel returned. R-13d must open these
stores, return the same checkpoint, and continue them.

`generator.rs.txt` is the program that wrote them. It compiles `src/authority.rs` as of each
commit (`git show <commit>:src/authority.rs`) next to it, with the dependencies of
`evidence/f8-bench/Cargo.toml.txt`. The stores cannot be regenerated by the current kernel.
